channels.fbGuideTitle: How to get a Page Access Token
channels.fbGuide:
How to get a Page Access Token (for a Page you administer):
1. Go to developers.facebook.com → Create App, type "Business".
2. Add the "Facebook Login for Business" product.
3. Open the Graph API Explorer: developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer
4. Pick your app under "Meta App"; under "User or Page" choose "Get Page Access Token" and select your Page.
5. Add permissions: pages_manage_posts and pages_read_engagement → click "Generate Access Token" and approve.
6. Copy the token (this is a SHORT-lived token, ~1-2 hours).
7. Exchange it for a LONG-lived token (~60 days): open developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/accesstoken → paste → "Extend Access Token" → copy the new token.
8. Paste the long-lived token into "Page Access Token" above, enter the Page ID, and Save.

Notes:
• Page ID: Page → About/Settings → "Page ID".
• A long-lived token (~60 days) eventually expires — if posting fails with a token error, get a new one and paste it again.
• For a Page you administer, no Facebook App Review is needed.
